title: October 7th Attack Tracker Update — Fri Sep 4, 2026
summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said Thursday, September 4 they killed Muhammad Mahmoud Marshad al-Qadi, the Hamas Nukhba commander who led the October 7 raid on Israel's Sufa outpost and later held hostages captive in Rafah, in a Khan Yunis strike. One day earlier, on September 3, Netanyahu's office published his full October 7 morning timeline for the first time, revealing he did not speak directly with then-IDF Chief of Staff Herzi Halevi until 9:55 a.m. — nearly 3.5 hours after the attack began; the October Council called the delay 'unfathomable' and election rival Yair Golan said it was 'unfathomable that Netanyahu was not in touch with Halevi' as towns were being overrun.
